remarks: Welcome to this bright and well maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo perched on the 7th floor in the heart of Mid-City Stamford. Enjoy sweeping city views from your private balcony and oversized window that floods the space with natural light.  The clean, updated kitchen features modern cabinetry, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances - perfect for cooking and entertaining. The open-concept living and dining area offers a versatile layout with plenty of room to relax.  Both bedrooms are generously sized with ample closet space. This well-managed building offers convenience and comfort, with easy access to houses of worship, shops, restaurants, parks, and public transportation.  This condo offers a fantastic opportunity to own in one of Stamford's most desirable locations. Don't miss out on city living at its best! Best & Final Tuesday May 13th @ 12PM
